programme.title: Zubin Metha - Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust. Interwoven with individual biographies and archival footage, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra’s 75 years of history are brought back to life in concerts featuring Arturo Toscanini, Arthur Rubinstein, Leonard Bernstein, Isaac Stern, Zubin Mehta, Daniel Barenboim and Itzhak Perlman. We also get the opportunity to watch the Israel Philharmonic in rehearsals, concerts and on tour

programme.title: Ernst Märzendorfer, Slovak Philharmonic Choir, Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra And Kristiane Kaiser - Verdi - La traviata
programme.desc: This production of Giuseppe Verdi's popular opera La Traviata was performed outdoors at the St. Margarethen Festival in 2008 by the Slovak Philharmonic Orchestra under the direction of Ernst Märzendorfer. Soloists Kristiane Kaiser, Magdalena Anna Hofmann, and Stefanie Kopinits perform in a striking physical setting against the backdrop of the Austrian mountains. Several men are courting the rich courtesan Violetta, but when she meets Alfredo, she chooses to live a new life with him. She then moves from Paris to the French countryside, but unfortunately is haunted by her past: Alfredo's father does not approve of his past and convinces her to abandon his son. Alfredo is ignorant of his father's torment and, thinking that Violetta has used him, he becomes furious. In the end, he understands that Violetta has abandoned him to be free, but it is too late. Reaching an incurable illness, Violetta dies in his arms.

programme.title: Mengjie Han - Liszt/Wagner - Tannhäuser Overture S.442
programme.desc: Mengjie Han (*1989) performs Franz Liszt’s transcription of Richard Wagner’s Tannhäuser Overture, S.442, during the quarter finals of the Liszt Piano Competition 2014.

programme.title: Iván Fischer - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Members of the Berliner Philharmoniker, Hansjorg Schellenberger, Andreas Wittmann And Karl Leister - Beethoven's Octet and Dvořák's Serenade
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is an orchestra based in Berlin, Germany and is ranked as one of the best orchestras in the world. In 1990, orchestra members played beautiful chamber music, such as Ludwig van Beethoven's Octet in E-flat major and Antonin Dvořák's Serenade in D minor. Even though both compositions were written for wind instruments, Beethoven reworked and expanded his String Quartet No. 1 for this composition. The performance was recorded at the famous Jaspis-Hall in the New Chambers, besides Sanssouci, the Summer Palace of Friedrich the Great.

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Stravinsky - Symphony in Three Movements
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance. The orchestra opens with an outstanding performance of Stravinsky’s Symphony in Three Movements.

programme.title: Samuel Hasselhorn And Daniel Heide - Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827). In twenty-four songs, we follow a rejected young man on a lonely journey through a frozen landscape. Wandering as a lost soul, tormented by his memories, the man searches for peace. This performance was recorded at Schloss Wörlitz, part of the Dessau-Wörlitz Garden Realm, near Dessau, the birthplace and final resting place of Wilhelm Müller.

programme.title: Robert Windak, Annemarie van Vliegen, Eva Šušliková And Réne Geesing - Christmas Concert
programme.desc: On 18 December 2017, the Valerius Ensemble played a Christmas concert in Concordia, Enschede. The ensemble consists of Robert Windak (violin), Annemarie van Vliegen (violin), Eva Šušliková (viola) and Réne Geesing (cello). The program consists of “Das neugeborne Kindelein” from Bachs Cantata BWV 122, the Largo from Vivaldi’s Winter, the Allegro from Mozart’s Divertimento in D (KV. 136), Méditation from Massenet’s opera “Thaïs,” The Entertainer by Scott Joplin, the Vilja song from Léhars “Die Lustige Witwe” and the animated Romanian folk-tune Geampara. The Ensemble closes with Piazzolla’s Ave Maria (Tanti anni prima).

programme.title: Gottfried von der Goltz - Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret? The internationally acclaimed pianist and Bach expert Robert Levin provides an answer.

programme.title: Inna Faliks - Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846

programme.title: Isabelle Faust - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Daniel Reuss, Cappella Amsterdam, Festival Oude Muziek And Utrecht Early Music Festival - Josquin’s motets
programme.desc: In 15th-century polyphony suffering is, after love, possibly the most important theme. As in the Flemish Primitives’ paintings, the tears flow copiously in the oeuvre of composers such as Josquin Desprez. With this selection of Josquin’s finest dark timbres (Miserere mei, De profundis, Absalon fili mi), Cappella Amsterdam guarantees us a breathtaking programme with a palette of muted colours.

programme.title: John Adams - The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” (2018) is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). The documentary sheds light on Ives’s life and work in all its facets, exploring his aural world by showing music performances in churches, concert halls, open-air venues, and a circus tent. Using interviews with relatives, insurance brokers, musicologists, and musicians, documentary filmmaker Anne-Kathrin Peitz explores the question “who was Charles Ives?

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt And Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Ying Li - PIAM - Final: Beethoven, Chopin and Prokofiev
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. During the competition’s final round, Ying Li (China, 1997) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 28 in A major, Op. 101; Frédéric Chopin’s Fantasia in F minor, Op. 49; and Sergei Prokofiev’s Sonata No. 7 in B-flat major, Op. 83. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatory of Milan, in July 2021.

programme.title: Anton Schaburov - Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016. On the program are well-known classical pieces, like the third movement of Vivaldi’s “Summer” from Four Seasons, Mussorgky’s “Night on Bald Mountain,” and “Habanera” from Bizet’s Carmen. Tenor Alan Pingarrón sings “Gratia plena,” by Mario Talavera, and “Dime Que Si,” by Alfonso Oteo. On the program are also famous orchestral works like the Adagietto from Mahler’s Symphony No. 5, and the third movement of Rachmaninoff’s Symphony No. 3.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset And Øystein Moen - Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström’ (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass’s work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten’s spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe’s story.

programme.title: Hannu Lintu And Fins Radio Symfonie Orkest - Sibelius - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy. His many concerts with the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra in 2012 made him the obvious replacement for Sakari Oramo, who, after many years as conductor and concert master, terminated his contract in 2012. The orchestra specializes in the performance of Finnish music, but also performs the great masterpieces of Gustav Mahler and Béla Bartók. The Finnish composer Jean Sibelius is the orchestra’s favourite, as well as the conductor. In cooperation with Finland’s national public broadcasting company Yle, all seven Sibelius symphonies are recorded and broadcast. After a brief spoken introduction about the piece, the orchestra performs the complete symphony. After Sibelius was diagnosed with throat cancer in 1908, he changed his lifestyle as well as his approach to composition. Fearing death, he quit using alcohol and tobacco. Simultaneously, the harmonies in his works grew darker and more sombre. Devils and death are among the images conjured up by the gloomy sounds of this Symphony.

programme.title: Hervé Niquet And Le Concert Spirituel - Handel at Chambord Castle
programme.desc: This 2016 concert at Chambord Castle in France under the direction of Hervé Niquet features 70 musicians that gave a spectacular performance of Handel‘s Water Music and Music for the Royal Fireworks. In between Le Concert Spirituel also plays Concerto Grosso’s No. 4 and No. 5 also by Georg Friedrich Handel. After that you can enjoy the celebrated movement of Marc- Antoine Charpentier’s Te Deum, now universally known as the signature tune of Eurovision. The music brings to mind the splendor at the court of King Louis XIV, who sojourned in Chambord on several occasions.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Daniel Barenboim - Albéniz - Iberia Book 1 And 2
programme.desc: On August 19, 2000, the Teatro Colón was filled to the brim with spectators longing to hear Daniel Barenboim play the piano. On the program: Ludwig van Beethoven's Sonata No. 23 ‘Apassionata’, Frederic Chopin's Waltz in e minor, and more.

programme.title: Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, Truls Mørk, Lisa Batiashvili And Sir Simon Rattle - Europakonzert 2007 - Berlin
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker. Under the theme The Year 1882, the acclaimed orchestra is lead by conductor Sir Simon Rattle as it interprets Brahms’ “Concerto for violin, cello and orchestra”, his Fourth Symphony and Wagners’ “Prelude to Act I” from Parsifal - the piece that marked the orchestra's first recorded work of September 1913 under the baton of Alfred Hertz. The soloists are Lisa Batiashvili (violin) and Truls Mørk (cello), established as sought-after young virtuosos and appearing regularly with leading orchestras and in recitals throughout the world. The “Kraftwerk und Kabelwerk Oberspree (power and cable factory)”, the remarkable venue of this concert, is one of the most impressive historical industrial building from the late 19th century in Berlin. As its impressive presence is infused with Brahms and Wagner, there is an air of total commitment, only enhanced further by the unusual surroundings. The collaboration of Lisa Batiashvili and Truls Mørk ensures a moving performance of Brahms’s last orchestral work, his Double Concerto. Following this, Rattle and the orchestra continue to demonstrate their outstanding musicianship, delivering Wagner's amazingly fresh and dynamic Fourth Symphony.

programme.title: Roberto Giordano - Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris. The main section of the ballade is built from two main themes which return in different keys after which a thundering chord introduces the Presto con fuoco, which eventually ends the piece in a fiery double octave scale run down the keyboard. The work gained popularity after appearing on the soundtrack to the 2002 Roman Polanski film The Pianist, where it is played by Janusz Olejniczak.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Christoph Eschenbach, Konzerthausorchester Berlin And Rundfunkchor Berlin - Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself. For this production, Catalan theatre group La Fura dels Baus – internationally acclaimed for its avant-garde opera – created a virtual forest in the Konzerthaus’ Great Hall, delivering a thrilling new interpretation of Von Weber’s Romantic opera. Stage director Carlus Padrissa calls this 2021 production a “journey to the roots of opera, where myth, history and the current reality of the forest meet”. Christoph Eschenbach conducts Konzerthausorchester Berlin and Rundfunkchor Berlin. Among the soloists are Jeanine De Bique (Agathe), Anna Prohaska (Ännchen), Benjamin Bruns (Max), Falk Struckmann (Kaspar), Franz Hawlata (Kuno), and Viktor Rud (Kilian). This performance was recorded on June 18, 2021.

programme.title: Václav Luks And Collegium 1704 - Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. In this performance at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany, Luks and his Collegium 1704 present Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 6 in B-flat major, BWV 1051. Contrary to the other five concertos, this piece does not include violins, instead offering the floor to the lower strings and the harpsichord.

programme.title: Casco Phil And Benjamin Haemhouts - Shostakovich - Chamber Symphony Op. 110a
programme.desc: The Casco Phil, The Chamber Music Orchestra of Belgium, conducted by Benjamin Haemhouts, performs Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony, Op. 110a. The work is a transcription by Rudolf Barshai of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8, which was composed in only three days (July 12 to 14 1960). The work draws from Shostakovich’s pieces, like the Symphonies No. 1 and 5, and a Jewish theme from Piano Trio No. 2. Furthermore, it contains melodies from the first Cello Concerto and the Lady MacBeth opera. Recorded at the Elisabeth Center in Antwerp, Belgium.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic And David Cohen - Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Myung-whun Chung, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino And Christiane Karg - Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists. Mahler explores themes of life, death, and resurrection throughout the symphony. Its first movement resembles a funeral march, while the second, a graceful Ländler, creates a stark contrast with the somber character of the first. The third movement is a Scherzo based on Mahler’s musical setting of ‘Des Antonius von Padua Fischpredigt’ from the collection Des Knaben Wunderhorn. The composer also used another Wunderhorn poem, ‘Urlicht’ (Primal Light), for the fourth movement, incorporating both text and music, sung by the alto. The chorus makes its entrance in the second part of the fifth and final movement with the ‘Resurrection’ chorale. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Berliner Philharmoniker - Discovering Masterpieces – Beethoven No. 5
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Ludwig van Beethoven’s ‘Symphony No. 5’ is discussed. The piece has the character of an appeal from the very start, when the four-note “fate” motif casts a spell on listeners. The German musicologist Armin Koch analyses the work, while the German Beethoven expert Wulf Konold illustrates the ingenious variations of the “fate” motif on piano, and also explains other features of this magnificent work.

programme.title: Staatskapelle Berlin, Staatsopernchor And Pierre Boulez - Boulez conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Pierre Boulez conducts the orchestra and choirs of the Berlin State Opera and the orchestra of the Staatskapelle Berlin in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2. This concert is part of a series of events celebrating the French conductor and composer's 80th birthday. With his uncompromising approach to the score, Boulez's Mahler readings have long fascinated critics and audiences alike. Vocalists Diana Damrau and Petra Lang join forces to bring Boulez’s vision of this gargantuan piece to life. This concert was recorded at the Staatskapelle Berlin in 2005.

programme.title: Riccardo Schwartz - Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwarz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Vladimir Ashkenazy And Royal Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 12, K 414
programme.desc: Vladimir Ashkenazy performs as a soloist and conductor in Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 12, K 414. He is accompanied by the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra at the Hampton Court Palace, London.

programme.title: Sarah Hicks - Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann. Soloists for this performance are Tuva Semmingsen (mezzo), Christine Nonbo Andersen (soprano), Hans Ulrik (saxophone) and Mads Kjølby (guitars). Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark in 2018.

programme.title: amarcordplus And Sebastian Heindl - Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach. Moreover, various sacred works by lesser-known contemporaries Philipp Heinrich Erlebach and mononymous composer Liebhold are performed, in addition to compositions by other members of the Bach family, including Johann Michael Bach and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020.

programme.title: Daniel Rowland, Rachel Roberts, Julian Arp And Diana Ketler - Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet. The young composer started writing the Piano Quartet in C minor in the spring of 1884 and completed it one year later. The work is in four movements and shows considerable influence from Johannes Brahms. It premiered on December 8, 1885 in Weimar and was performed by members of the Halír Quartet with Strauss himself playing the piano part. The following year the work won the first prize given by the Berliner Tonkünstlerverein for a piano quartet. This performance was recorded at the Stiftkerk in Weerselo, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Günter Atteln - Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production. In this exciting documentary, we go behind-the-scenes at the Zurich Opera House and follow the intensive progress of the new production of Gioachino Rossini's Il Barbiere di Siviglia with Vesselina Kasarova in the role of Rosina. The film also shows preparations for other productions, such as a workshop for Richard Wagner's Siegfried directed by Robert Wilson, and a rehearsal for Igor Stravinsky's Le Sacre du Printemps with choreography by Heinz Spoerli. This film opens the curtain to understanding an opera house’s many exciting facets.

programme.title: Martha Argerich - Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op. 94; Frédéric Chopin’s Impromptu No. 3, Op. 51, Polonaise No. 6, Op. 53 “Heroic”, and Waltz No. 6, Op. 64 No. 1; Camille Saint-Saëns’s Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77; César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major; and Fritz Kreisler’s Liebesleid and Schön Rosmarin. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Les Dissonances - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Artem Belogurov And Octavie Dostaler-Lalonde - Works for cello and fortepiano by Beethoven
programme.desc: Every year in late August, the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is the world's largest festival focused on early music, attracting an audience of over 70 thousand visitors. Due to the corona pandemic, the 2020 edition of the festival took place in an alternative form, offering an alternative program that included live concerts as well as daily livestreams of concerts and archive recordings. As part of this festival edition, forte pianist Artem Belogurov and cellist Octavie Dostaler-Lalonde present a program devoted to works by Ludwig van Beethoven. The duo met in Amsterdam in 2015, performing many recitals at several European and North American festivals and in concert halls. On the program are Beethoven's Variations for cello and forte piano on ‘Bei Männern, welche Liebe fühlen’ from W. A. Mozart's Die Zauberflöte, WoO 46, Rondo in C major for fortepiano, Op. 51 no. 1, Rondo in G major for fortepiano, Op. 51 no. 2, and Sonata in F major for cello and fortepiano, Op. 5 no. 1. This concert was recorded at St. Gertrude's Chapel in Utrecht on August 27, 2020.

programme.title: Uwe Scholz - Soulscapes
programme.desc: In retrospect, the version for solo dance of Stravinsky’s Sacre du printemps can be interpreted as a bleak, oppressive dance about his own life. The ballet is one of the late works by Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the twentieth century. During his short life, this wunderkind created over 100 ballets, including major stage successes such as Die Schöpfung, Die Grosse Messe and Bruckner 8. Scholz is regarded as a sensitive, highly musical artist with a fine sense of humor, but he was consistently plagued by an excruciating sense of perfectionism, self-doubt and fear. At times, this made work impossible for him. “Sometimes the great artist’s path does not lead to laurel-wreathed solitude, but to deep despair,” writes the ballet critic Klaus Geitel looking back on Scholz’s life. The film Soulscapes is a highly personal, moving portrait of Uwe Scholz, who died on November 21, 2004, at the age of 45. In one of his last interviews with the director Günter Atteln, Scholz talks about himself and his work with unprecedented candor. “I’m drawn to symphonic music from the classical and romantic periods,” he says. “I simply need these soulscapes.”

programme.title: Isabelle Faust - Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach’s incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). Both works are part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire. In this Chaconne, Bach develops a series of continuous variations from a theme, exploring a complex range of harmonic possibilities. Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging pieces. This performance was recorded at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, in 2020.

programme.title: Costanza Principe - Bach – Italian Concerto And Chaconne (arr. Busoni)
programme.desc: Italian classical pianist Costanza Principe (1993) started playing the piano at age 6, making her public debut at age 7. Before long she would be performing as a soloist with numerous prestigious orchestras in Italy, the UK, France, and South America. Seen here in 2021 at one of Italy’s oldest extant Renaissance theatres, the gorgeous Teatro Olimpico in the northern Italian town of Vicenza, Principe performs Johann Sebastian Bach’s ‘Concerto italiano’ and ‘Ciaccona’, as transcribed for piano by Ferruccio Busoni.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons - Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major Surprise. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church Hagia Eirene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Trio Arabica, Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, Tafelmusik Chamber Choir And Maryem Toller - Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century. The cities of Leipzig and Damascus both lay at the crossroads of ancient trading routes and are important centres of scholarship and famous for their coffee houses, where music was performed by the most brilliant musicians of the day. This concert presents works by Bach, Telemann, Handel and treasures of classical Arabic music. In this cross-cultural café, music, words, and images are used to explore the ways in which people separated by great distances are bound together by trade, ideas, and art. Recorded at the Aga Khan Museum in Toronto. Created by Alison Mackay and staging by Marshall Pynkoski.

programme.title: Les Dissonances And David Grimal - Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. Violin Concerto No. 3 opens with a theme the composer borrowed from the aria ‘Aer tranquillo’ of his then recent opera Il re pastore. In the beautiful Adagio, the strings are muted and the oboes make way for the flutes, which only sound in the second movement. The finale movement has a dance-like character. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: The Imperial Ice Stars - Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)
programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars are an ensemble of 24 world class skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them. Praised by critics and audiences alike, they never fail to enchant with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes. Set to the original score of Tchaikovsky's masterpiece, the Imperial Ice Stars present their 2015 Ice Dance interpretation of Swan Lake, complete with an exhilarating choreography from leading ice director Tony Mercer. “Inspired by my research into Tchaikovsky’s original score and intentions for the story, I wanted to create a more realistic interpretation of this much-loved tale and transpose it onto ice, creating a new art form in the process – ice dance in a full theatrical setting,” the choreographer explains. “I always felt it was a natural fit, to have swans gliding on ice.”

programme.title: Young Sun Choi, Seunghyuk Na And Ivan Basic - Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. The finalists are Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991), Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997), and Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996).

programme.title: Olivier Latry, Emmanuel Curt, Shin-Young Lee And Damien Petitjean - Le Grand Orgue in Concert
programme.desc: Current holder of “Great Organ of the Notre Dame,” Olivier Latry began his musical career when he enrolled in Gaston Litaize’s organ class at the Academy of Saint-Maur at the age of 16. In 1985, at 23 years of age, Latry was awarded the post of one of four “titulaires des grands orgues” of Notre Dame, Paris. Besides enriching the musical world as an organist, improvisor and composer, Olivier Latry also works as a Professor of Organ at the Conservatoire de Paris. This performance of his, showcasing pieces of Bach, Vierne and Daquin, was recorded in 2015, at Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris.

programme.title: Roberto Prosseda - Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn. Since 2012, Prosseda also gives lecture-concerts with the robot pianist TeoTronico, as educational or family concerts, to demonstrate differences between a literal production of music and human interpretation.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto And Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería - Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. This performance was recorded at Auditorio Nacional in Mexico City, in 2021.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Estonian National Ballet - Tchaikovsky - The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's The Nutcracker is one of the best known and most beloved pieces from the composer. The music has inspired many choreographers to the tell the colourful Christmas fairy-tale of E. T. A. Hoffmann and Alexandre Dumas senior in the language of dance. Ben Stevenson is to this day considered one of the most important influencers of the American ballet art. For almost thirty years, he has been the art director of the Houston Ballet, and under his leadership the company has grown into an internationally acknowledged ballet theatre. Since the year 2003 he’s held the position of Artistic Director of the Texas Ballet. His stage productions have earned several awards and praise from the critics, and have been staged at Opéra de Paris, Canadian National Ballet, La Scala, Bavarian State Opera, London City Ballet etc. This performance of the Nutcracker is recorded at the Teatro La Fenice (Venice) in 2012. With the Estonian National Ballet and star dancers Vladislav Lantratov and Galina Laush.

programme.title: Leonard Slatkin And Orchestre National de Lyon - Beethoven - Triple Concerto, Op. 56
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.title: Leonidas Kavakos And Yuja Wang - Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition. With Yuja Wang, an accomplished artist at young age herself, he forms a masterful duo of chamber music interpretation. The programme features Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 1 in G major, Op. 78, also known as the Regensonate, Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 2 in A major, Op. 100, the Thuner Sonata, a portrait of the Swiss lake of Thun's peaceful scenery. It comes to a fiery and passionate finale with Brahm's Sonata for Piano and Violin, No. 3 in D minor, Op 108.

programme.title: Les Dissonances And David Grimal - Schubert - Symphony No. 8 in B minor, D. 759
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance Les Dissonances perform Franz Schubert’s Symphony No. 8 in B minor, D. 759, also known as the ‘Unfinished Symphony’. Schubert started composing the work in 1822, but only completed the first two movements. The first movement, Allegro moderato, has a dark, mysterious mood, which contrasts with the beautiful second movement in E major, Andante con moto. Schubert only penned a couple of measures of the third movement, a Scherzo, in full score. It is not known why the composer never finished his symphony. Although it is not complete, it has become one of Schubert’s most popular compositions. This performance was recorded at Cité de la musique in Paris, France, in 2013.

programme.title: Iván Fischer - Dvořák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvořák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvořák’s broader oeuvre. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, on January 29, 2021.

programme.title: Claudio Abbado, Berliner Philharmoniker, Swedish Radio Choir And Eric Ericson Chamber Choir - Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. In 2000, the orchestra played at home in the Berlin Philharmonic Hall.

programme.title: Charles Bélisle - Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance. Every summer, 500 music students from around the world gather for an intensive course program featuring: masterclasses, individual lessons, chamber music sessions, lectures, and special workshops.

programme.title: Riccardo Frizza, Orchestra Gli Originali, Coro Donizetti Opera And Caterina Sala - Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina. After hearing about the legend of Tristan and Isolde, the desperate Nemorino wonders if a love potion would help him to gain Adina’s love. He seeks help of the travelling quack Dr. Dulcamara, from whom he purchases a bottle of magic elixir. Directed by Frederic Wake-Walker, this 2021 production is unique as it features the complete, original score as reconstructed by Alberto Zedda based on Donizetti’s autographs. In addition, the orchestra plays on historical instruments to recreate the sound of Donizetti’s orchestra. Among the soloists are Caterina Sala (Adina), Javier Camarena (Nemorino), Florian Sempey (Belcore), Roberto Frontali (Dulcamara), Anaïs Mejías (Giannetta), and Manuel Ferreira (Master of ceremonies). This performance was part of the Donizetti Opera Festival, recorded at Teatro Donizetti in Bergamo, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Philipp Scheucher - PIAM - Semi-final: Beethoven and Liszt
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano. As part of this competition, Philipp Scheucher (Austria, 1993) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Fantasia Op. 77; Menuetto: ‘Moderato e grazioso’ from Beethoven’s Sonata No. 18 in E-flat major, Op. 31 No. 3; and Franz Liszt’s transcription of the first movement, ‘Allegro con brio’, from Beethoven’s Symphony No. 5 in C minor. This performance was recorded at Nuovo Teatro Ariberto in Milan, in May 2021.

programme.title: Jodie Devos - Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Jeffrey Tate And English Chamber Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 36, K. 425
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the English Chamber Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s “Linzer” Symphony No. 36 (K. 425). The broadcast is directed by János Darvas. Mozart composed the work in 1783, during his short stay in the Austrian town of Linz, on the way home from Vienna to Salzburg. The symphony was written in an impressive span of only four days to accommodate a local concert. The premier took place on November 4 and premiered in Vienna the year after. The introduction of trumpets and drums in the second movement is an unusual feature of the piece. The closing Presto is provided with some contrapuntal passages to contrast the homophonic texture.

programme.title: Thomas Zehetmair, Ivan Fischer And Budapest Festival Orchestra - Prokofiev - Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky. On the program is music composed for the ballet 'Jeu de cartes' (1937) and the Firebird Suite, No. 2 (1919). 'Jeu de cartes' is one of Stravinsky's neo-classical works and consists of three parts ('deals'). The Firebird Suite, No. 2 is based on the music from the ballet of the same name, which was written for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes and premiered in Paris in 1910.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Herbert Blomstedt And Lucerne Festival Orchestra - Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Så byggdes Sverige - teckenspråkstolkat
programme.desc: Centrums stora förvandlingsresa börjar i Örebro 1930 när Mark Isitt och Gert Wingårdh spanar in Sveriges första EPA-varuhus. Gert besöker världens första inomhusgalleria som öppnar i Luleå 1955 och Petra Mede testar att handla alldeles själv i Sveriges första snabbköp. Resan fortsätter via KF-högkvarteret vid Slussen varifrån Sverige ritas om med Domus-varuhus och slutar på hela Sveriges allra centralaste torg. Hur ska det gå för våra gamla torg när handeln flyttat ifrån våra stadskärnor?

programme.title: Bluey kortfilmer
programme.desc: Pappa har köpt en helt ny Bingo 3000-robot, men den fungerar inte som den ska, så han ringer teknisk support.

programme.title: I drömmarnas trädgård
programme.desc: BBC-serie för de allra minsta. Tomblibooernas torn. Vi möter Daisy, Igglepiggle, Makka Pakka och några till. De bor i en vacker trädgård och är med om många upptäckter och äventyr.

programme.title: Molnbebbarna
programme.desc: Högt ovan marken, ända uppe bland molnen, bor Molnbebbarna - de som tar hand om allt som händer däruppe på dagen och natten.

programme.title: Daniel Tigers kvarter

Men med Jon och Jennys vilja finns inga hinder, för hur svårt kan det vara att rita och bygga ett hus?

programme.title: Husdrömmar

Samtidigt börjar hon hitta sin egen blick som filmskapare. Svensk-belgisk dokumentär från 2025.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: Efterlyst är ett av Sveriges äldsta tv-program, som under flera säsonger har hjälpt polisen att lösa hundratals grova brott, främst tack vare tittarna. Programmet sänds live från Stockholm med poliser och experter i studion och på plats där brotten händer, runt om i Sverige. Tittarna får inte bara de senaste nyheterna utan också en helhetsbild av de aktuella brotten, som ofta kan vara svåra att överblicka när rubrikerna briserar i medierna.

programme.title: I huvudet på en gärningsman
programme.desc: Som gärningsman är 20-åringen en utredares värsta mardröm. En ensamvarg som bestämt sig för att mörda. Han har en strulig skolgång och inga nära vänner. När han hoppar av gymnasiet börjar isoleringen från omvärlden. Hemma på pojkrummet växer de mörka tankarna. Känslan av hopplöshet och misslyckande är ständig närvarande. Nu vill han åstadkomma något som andra pratar om. I en text formulerar han sina tankar om att allt han vill är att begå ett mord. Under 2018 och 2019 begår 20-åringen flera brutala överfall med en hammare mot personer som är ute och promenerar i Sollentuna. Ett av offren kommer att sväva mellan liv och död och får men för livet. Upprymd över uppmärksamhet kring vad han gjort ringer gärningsmannen till SOS alarm och berättar om sina brutala överfall. Det leder i sin tur till att han slutligen kan gripas.

Désormais adulte, Laurie entame une quête personnelle pour se reconnecter à sa culture d'origine et rencontrer sa mère biologique. À 28 ans, elle décide de franchir le pas et s'envole direction Wallis. Un voyage de plus de 18 000 kilomètres vers ses racines.

programme.desc: La rumeur d'un monstre boueux parvient aux dinos, et Mazu est déterminée à le « trouver ». Elle ne pense pas qu'il existe et veut découvrir ce qui se cache derrière cette créature qui effraie tout le monde. Marshall veut l'aider, mais elle ne lui accorde pas beaucoup d'attention. Mais lorsqu'elle fait face au monstre boueux, c'est Marshall qui sauve la situation, et Mazu réalise qu'elle n'aurait pas dû le sous-estimer.

programme.desc: La capitaine Tonus et Neurone reçoivent la question de la petite Sofia. Mon papa me dit toujours que je dois bien boire quand je joue au foot... pourquoi ?. Capitaine Tonus et Neurone expliquent, en visitant le rein dans le Positron miniaturisé, que quand on ne boit pas assez quand on perd de l'eau, par exemple en transpirant quand on a une activité physique, cela n'est pas bon pour le corps. C'est pour cela qu'il faut bien boire quand on fait du sport et qu'on transpire.

programme.title: LES QUIQUOI
programme.desc: Olive, Pétole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul et Pamela forment la joyeuse bande des Quiquoi. Ils se posent une foule de questions existentielles qu'ils essayent de résoudre à l'aide de dessins. À leur manière plutôt loufoque, ils adorent créer des univers surréalistes dans lesquels tout devient possible. Réalisation : Eugène Boitsov (France/Belgique, 2022)

programme.title: L'IMAGIER ANIMÉ DE KOUMI

programme.title: 1001 MONDES ANTIQUES
programme.desc: Braillard, Colombe et Lablatte ont découvert le moyen de voyager à travers les époques et les civilisations anciennes. Ils s'embarquent dans un voyage temporel, passant par de civilisations populaires telles que l'Égypte et la Grèce antique, ainsi qu'en Afrique sub-saharienne, au Moyen-Orient ou en Mésopotamie.

programme.title: ALIX ET LES MERVEILLEUX
programme.desc: Alix rejoint Chapelier au pays des Merveilleux. Depuis qu'il porte un étrange chapeau de corsaire, il semble s'être transformé en pirate et vole les affaires de ses amis pour garnir son trésor...

programme.title: UNE BRIQUE DANS LE VENTRE
programme.desc: Maison de famille à la décoration zen Visite d'une maison de famille à la décoration douce et zen qui invite au repos et à la déconnexion dans le nord de la France. Également : découverte de la ferme de Petit Bomal ; un point avec Anne sur le photovoltaïque ; comment monter une clôture en châtaignier.

programme.title: CHRONIQUES MÉDITERRANÉENNES NATURE
programme.desc: L'Estérel, côté terre Le massif volcanique de l'Estérel s'étend de la Provence à la Méditerranée. Véritable kaléidoscope de couleurs, il n'est ni une réserve naturelle ni un parc mais est néanmoins protégé par ses habitants.

programme.title: L'ÉPICERIE
programme.desc: Toutes les pâtes alimentaires contiennent à peu près les mêmes ingrédients mais comment expliquer les différences de prix ? Et y a-t-il vraiment des différences de qualité ; comment bien cuire les pâtes ; la performance des athlètes passe aussi par l'assiette ; la polenta sous toutes ses formes.

programme.title: PARTIR UN JOUR

Elle est sur le point d’ouvrir son premier restaurant à Paris lorsque l’infarctus de son père la ramène dans son village natal. Les souvenirs d’enfance refont surface, et un amour de jeunesse ressurgit… Peu à peu, ce retour aux sources bouscule ses choix de vie.

programme.title: 47 POUCES
programme.desc: Une nuit, Zélie, 7 ans, voit sa tante Clara débarquer dans la maison familiale. La jeune femme est triste, porte des bandages aux poignets et ne quitte pas sa chambre.

programme.title: LES MINUS
programme.desc: LES MINUS c'est de la comédie, de l'amitié... et des bricolages ! Bienvenue à Minusville, une ville unique, créée par des jouets avec des emballages du quotidien. Oli, une poupée pleine d’idées et d'énergie et son meilleur copain Titus, un petit jouet fan de bricolage. Ensemble, ils bricolent des constructions pour résoudre les problèmes de leurs copains...car à Minusville, vivre ensemble n’est pas toujours facile. Tout le monde veut s’amuser... mais chacun à sa façon !

programme.title: LES CROQUEMOUTARD
programme.desc: Fraîchement installée à la cité à des clapiers, la famille Croquemoutard est surprise de découvrir les petites manies des humains qui les entourent. Entre confrontations de mœurs et coutumes, pas sûr que les plus bizarres soient ceux que l’on croit…

programme.title: LIAM
programme.desc: À l'expo-sciences, c'est le début de la compétition. Rafaële s'y infiltre pour parler à Hélène de la soudaine augmentation de consommation d'énergie de Liam. L'androïde doit rester caché, mais il a envie de découvrir le monde réel.

programme.title: T'ES AU TOP

L'échange se poursuit avec un.e psychologue ou psychiatre, qui invite l'enfant à regarder différemment la problématique, et propose des conseils pratiques. programme.desc: Hela gruppen medverkar i den klassiska filmen G.I. Joe från 1980-talet. Det hela fungerar som kristerapi för Jeff som samtidigt handskas med en stor livshändelse.

programme.title: Fresh Prince i Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will hamnar i slagsmål med en man utklädd till Nickys hjälte valen Dougie, och känner sig frestad att tala om för Nicky att hans ”hjälte” inte är verklig. Hilary parkerar på Leeza Gibbons plats och får ta konsekvenserna av det.

programme.title: Fresh Prince i Bel-Air
programme.desc: Will får äntligen en dejt med Valerie, hans drömtjej. Men när han tvingas till en dubbeldejt upptäcker Will chockat att Valerie kanske föredrar Carlton framför honom själv.

programme.title: Community
programme.desc: Shirley får reda på att Jeff bor i sin bil men klassar honom inte som hemlös då han snarare bara råkat bli utelåst efter att ha haft lite problem med sina räkningar.

programme.title: Community
programme.desc: Greendale Colleges debattlag ska snart tävla och Annie får plötsligt reda på att hon inte längre har en partner. Då Jeff var en framgångsrik advokat innan han skrev in sig på college, bestämmer sig Annie, Dean Pelson och lagets coach, Professor Whitman, för att fråga honom om han kan tänka sig att delta i tävlingen.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Jack lurar Maya att få en granne att flytta – allt för att kunna bygga ett ångrum på jobbet.

programme.title: Just Shoot Me!
programme.desc: Finch är övertygad om att Nina har ett påhittat alter ego. Maya upptäcker att Jack lurade henne på Halloween för många år sedan.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Medan Liz förbereder sig inför rättegången, gör Red allt för att skydda henne från Cabal.

programme.title: The Blacklist
programme.desc: Red gör specialstyrkan uppmärksam på ett topphemligt möte mellan världens mäktigaste maffialedare som kallats in för att straffa honom för sammarbetet med FBI.AC

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Janes senaste uppdrag går ut på att fånga en grupp livsfarliga konsttjuvar. Lissabon kommer väl överens med en agent från specialstyrkan för konststölder.

programme.title: The Mentalist
programme.desc: Två dagar innan en man ska avrättas kämpar Jane och FBI för att försöka lösa ett ouppklarat fall och bevisa att han är oskyldig.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Als före detta partner blir skjuten och utredningen avslöjar att han kan ha varit en mycket ohederlig polis. Samtidigt anstränger sig Carrie för att trösta Al utan att bli alltför involverad.

programme.title: Spin City
programme.desc: Carter längtar efter att bli far, Stuart blir kär och borgmästarens motståndare använder smutsiga knep.

programme.title: Spin City
programme.desc: Stuarts romans kan hota Carters planer för föräldraskap. En synsk kampanjkonsult påverkar kontoret.

programme.title: Spin City
programme.desc: Charlies flirt kan äventyra borgmästarens omvalskampanj och Paul blir ett överraskande sexobjekt.

programme.title: Spin City
programme.desc: Charlie får spel när hans nya flickvän verkar vara kär i Caitlin.

programme.desc: Medan Bravo fortsätter att hantera stora förändringar, åker teamet på ett uppdrag i Ecuador. Dessutom presenterar Natalie en livsavgörande idé för Jason.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Teamet letar efter en saknad tonåring som man misstänker ha rekryterats till en terroristorganisation.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: När en fångtransport välter jagar Hondo och teamet tre kvinnliga rymlingar, däribland en seriemördare som är på gränsen till vansinnesdåd.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: I en nära framtid när jorden är på väg att dö upptäcks en mystisk spricka i rumtiden som öppnar möjligheter för människan att undersöka nya platser att överleva på. Den före detta NASA-ingenjören och skickliga piloten Cooper, numera jordbrukare som de flesta andra, tvingas lämna sina barn bakom sig när det visar sig att han är bäst lämpad att leda uppdraget ut i det okända.

programme.title: The Last Son
programme.desc: LeMay, en mördare och fredlös man, får veta av en spåman att han har en förbannelse över sig: han kommer att dödas av ett av sina egna barn. Kan han stoppa förbannelsen i tid?

programme.title: SEAL Team
programme.desc: Spänningarna mellan Jason och Ray når sin kulmen, och Lisa ställs inför sitt sista prov i utbildningen för att bli officier.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.

programme.title: Våra värsta år
programme.desc: Det är Als födelsedag och han ser fram emot att lösa in alla matkuponger han sparat. Precis när han ska gå och handla kommer det in en kund i skoaffären, men Al jagar iväg henne genom att tala om för henne att hon är tjock.

programme.title: Kolme muskettisoturia: D'Artagnan (15)
programme.desc: Uskonsodat ja brittien hyökkäyksen uhka ovat jakaneet kuningaskunnan. Kourallinen miehiä ja naisia käy taisteluun ja sitoo kohtalonsa Ranskan kohtaloon.

programme.title: Muumio: Lohikäärmekeisarin hauta (12)
programme.desc: Henkeäsalpaavassa toimintaseikkailussa nähdään vauhtia ja vaarallisia tilanteita, kun Rick O'Connellin poika Alex löytää lohikäärmekeisarin haudan ja siellä olevan muumion. Muumio kuljetetaan Shanghain museoon, mutta kaikki ei kuitenkaan mene aivan putkeen, joten koko O'Connellien perhe pääsee muumiojahtiin salaperäisen Lin-tytön avustuksella. 98 min. Ohjaus: Rob Cohen. Pääosissa: Brendan Fraser, Jet Li, John Hannah, Luke Ford, Maria Bello, Michelle Yeoh, Russell Wong.

programme.title: Lumikki ja Metsästäjä (12)
programme.desc: Lumikki varttuu aikuiseksi pahan ja taikavoimia omaavan äitipuolensa Ravennan vangitsemana. Kun Lumikki pääsee pakoon, Ravenna lähettää metsästäjän hänen peräänsä. 113 min. Ohjaus: Rupert Sanders. Pääosissa: Bob Hoskins, Brian Gleeson, Charlize Theron, Chris Hemsworth, Eddie Marsan, Ian McShane, Johnny Harris, Kristen Stewart, Lily Cole, Nick Frost, Ray Winstone, Sam Claflin, Toby Jones.

programme.title: Peppermint (15)
programme.desc: Viisi vuotta aiemmin Riley Northin mies ja tytär kuolivat järjettömässä väkivaltarikoksessa. Riley on päättänyt, että on aika kostaa sekä syyllisille että oikeusjärjestelmälle.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon (12)
programme.desc: Maailman kehittyneimmällä öljynporauslautalla 20. huhtikuuta 2010 alkaa muiden päivien tapaan. Yhtäkkinen onnettomuuksien sarja kuitenkin tekee Deepwater Horizonista räjähdys- ja tulipaloinfernon, jonka työntekijät jäävät luhistuvan porauslautan jättimäiseen kuolemanloukkuun.

programme.title: Prisoner of War (15)
programme.desc: Brittiläinen SAS-upseeri James Wright lähetetään auttamaan liittoutuneita amerikkalaisia ja filippiiniläisiä joukkoja taistelemaan japanilaisia vastaan toisen maailmansodan aikana. Tehtävänsä ainoana selviytyjänä Wright joutuu japanilaisten eristysleirille. Kun leirin johtaja huomaa Wrightin taistelutaidot, hän alkaa koetella vangin tahtoa pakottamalla Wrightin taistelemaan hengestään taitavimpia sotureitaan vastaan.

programme.title: Vengeance (18)
programme.desc: Teena ja hänen tyttärensä Bethie ovat palaamassa kotiin itsenäisyyspäivän iloisista juhlista, kun Teena raiskataan. Bethie tunnistaa hyökkääjät, mutta miesten asianajaja hoitaa nämä vapaaksi ja tahraa samalla Teenan maineen. Oikeusjärjestelmään pettynyt Teena kääntyy ensimmäisenä paikalla olleen poliisin Johnin puoleen. John ottaa oikeuden omiin käsiinsä ja etsii lain kouran ulottumattomissa olevat roistot.

programme.title: Oblivion (12)
programme.desc: Mekaanikko Jack Harper on yksi maapallon harvoista elossa olevista asukkaista. Haaliessaan Maan viimeisiä luonnonvaroja sodan runtelemalta planeetalta Harper pelastaa kauniin muukalaisen tuhoutuneesta avaruusaluksesta. Tämä käynnistää tapahtumasarjan, jonka jälkeen Jackin maailma ei ole enää entisensä, ja kaiken kyseenalaistamaan joutuva Jack tajuaa samalla, että ihmiskunnan kohtalo on hänen käsissään.

Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelun kanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta. programme.desc: Louvresta Buckinghamin palatsiin, Pariisin katuojista La Rochellen piiritykseen... Uskonsodat ja brittien hyökkäyksen uhka ovat jakaneet kuningaskunnan. Kourallinen miehiä ja naisia käy taisteluun ja sitoo kohtalonsa Ranskan kohtaloon.

programme.title: Transcendence (12)
programme.desc: Onko hän lopun alkua ihmiskunnalle? Tohtori Will Caster on yksi johtavista tekoälyn tutkijoista, mutta hänen kiistanalaiset kokeensa ovat tuoneet hänelle monta vihollista.

programme.title: Bandidas (12)
programme.desc: 1800-luvun lopun Meksikoon sijoittuva toimintakomedia kahdesta naisesta, Mariasta ja Sarasta, jotka päättävät yhdessä kostaa häikäilemättömälle pankkimagnaatille.

programme.title: The Doorman (15)
programme.desc: Kun pääsiäisenä luksuskerrostalo tyhjenee, käynnistyy suunnitelma arvokkaiden taideteosten varastamiseksi. Ovimestarin pitää estää sekä varkaat että pelastaa rakennuksessa olevat sukulaislapsensa.

programme.title: The Crow (15)
programme.desc: Sielunkumppanit Eric Draven ja Shelly Webster murhataan julmasti, kun demonit Shellyn synkästä menneisyydestä yllättävät heidät.

programme.title: Wild Mountain Thyme (12)
programme.desc: Rosemary haluaa kiihkeästi valloittaa Anthonyn sydämen. Loukkaantuneena isänsä suunnitelmista myydä maatilansa amerikkalaiselle sukulaispojalleen, Anthonyn on pakko ryhtyä tavoittelemaan unelmiaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming (12)
programme.desc: Nuori Peter Parker/Spider-Man alkaa totutella uuteen identiteettiinsä seittiä sinkoavana supersankarina. Peter palaa kotiinsa, jossa hän asuu May-tätinsä kanssa, ja elää uuden mentorinsa Tony Starkin valvovan katseen alla. Peter yrittää palata normaaliin arkirutiiniinsa, mutta kun uusi roisto Vulture ilmaantuu, kaikki Peterin sydäntä lähellä olevat asiat ovat uhattuina.

programme.title: Petteri Kaniini (7)
programme.desc: Petteri Kaniini elää huoletonta elämää kaikkien kaveriensa kanssa. Kunnes ilkeä naapuri muuttaa naapurustoon. Petterin täytyy kehittää täydellinen suunnitelma häätääkseen naapurinsa.

programme.title: Ainbo – Amazonin sademetsän rohkein tyttö (7)
programme.desc: Suomeksi puhutussa animaatiossa 13-vuotias Ainbo elää syvällä Amazonin viidakossa ja haluaa olla kunnioitettu soturi. Kun sademetsää uhkaa tuho, hän lähtee äitinsä hengen ohjaamana Dillo-vyötiäisen ja tapiiri Vacan kanssa matkalle etsimään apua voimakkaalta jättiläiskilpikonnalta Motelo Mamalta.

programme.title: Utelias Vili (0)
programme.desc: Animaatioelokuva Keltahattuisesta miehestä ja tämän lemmikkiapinasta, hurmaavan ilkikurisesta olennosta, jonka uteliaisuus johtaa usein hankaluuksiin.

programme.title: Megamind vs. Tuomiosyndikaatti (0)
programme.desc: Sankariksi muuttunut Megamind saa tehtäväkseen Metro Cityn suojelemisen. Hän joutuu koetukselle, kun hänen vanha konnatiiminsä uhkaa kaupunkia.

programme.title: Lego Elokuva (0)
programme.desc: Kaikkien aikojen ensimmäisessä täyspitkässä LEGO-elokuvassa seikkailee Emmet, aivan tavallinen LEGO-ukko, jota erehdytään luulemaan maailmanpelastajaksi.

programme.title: Iso kiltti jätti (7)
programme.desc: Sophie asuu Lontoon orpokodissa ja tapaa eräänä päivänä ison kiltin jätin, joka välittää unia nukkuvien lasten mieleen. Jätti vie Sophien kotimaailmaansa, jossa he keräävät yhdessä villejä unia nukkuvien nuorukaisten iloksi. Sophie on kuitenkin pian vaarassa, kun kiltin jätin isoveljet Fleshlumpeater, Bloodbottler ja Maidmasher huomaavat tytön. Pian epätavallinen parivaljakko laatii yhdessä suunnitelman ilkikuristen jättiläisten pään menoksi.

programme.title: Itse ilkimys (0)
programme.desc: Valkoisten aitojen ja kukkivien ruusupensaiden ympäröimällä onnellisella esikaupunkialueella on musta talo ja sen kuollut nurmikko. Naapurit eivät tiedä, että talossa on suuri salainen piilopaikka. Siellä asuu pienen kätyriarmeijan ympäröimä Gru joka suunnittelee maailmanhistorian suurinta ryöstöä.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda (7)
programme.desc: Po on nuudeleita maiskutteleva unelmoija, jonka täytyy hyväksyä itsensä vikoineen kaikkineen, jos hän mielii kehittyä legendaariseksi lohikäärmetaistelijaksi.

programme.title: Vuoden se kestää (12)
programme.desc: Ensitapaamisestaan lähtien kunnianhimoinen pintaliitäjä Nat ja kituuttava kirjailija Josh ovat olleet onnesta soikeina - erilaisuudestaan huolimatta. Heidän häänsä on kuin unelmien täyttymys, vaikka kukaan ei itse asiassa usko, että heidän liittonsa kestää vuotta pidempää. Lisäjännitystä arkeen tuo Joshin ex-tyttöystävä Chloe ja Natin komea amerikkalainen asiakas Guy, jotka onnistuvat horjuttamaan parin omaakin uskoa. Ensimmäisen vuosipäivän lähestyessä kumpikaan ei haluaisi olla se joka luovuttaa ensin, mutta kestääkö liitto siihen asti?

programme.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home (12)
programme.desc: Peter Parkerin (Tom Holland) elämä on hankaloitunut huomattavasti Mysterion paljastettua koko maailmalle, että hän on Spider-Man. Hän yrittää korjata tilanteen pyytämällä apua Doctor Strangelta (Benedict Cumberbatch), mutta vaarallisen loitsun mentyä pieleen tilanne ottaa askeleen entistä huonompaan suuntaan. Multiversumin rajojen murtuessa Peter saa vastaansa superroistoja eri maailmoista, mutta onneksi luvassa on apua odottamattomalta taholta. Kriitikoiden ylistämä jättihitti on tuottanut maailmanlaajuisesti lähes kaksi miljardia dollaria. Pääosissa: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch, Jacob Batalon, Jon Favreau, Marisa Tomei, Willem Dafoe. Ohjaus: Jon Watts.

programme.title: Forever My Girl (7)
programme.desc: Countrytähti Liam Page palaa kymmenen vuoden tauon jälkeen kotipaikkakunnalleen ja kohtaa taakseen jättämän rakkauden.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far from Home (12)
programme.desc: Ystävällinen supersankari lähtee parhaiden ystäviensä, Nedin, MJ:n ja muiden kanssa lomalle Eurooppaan. Peterin aikeet jättää supersankaruus tauolle unohtuvat, kun hän lupaa auttaa Nick Furya.

programme.title: Petteri Kaniini: Kani karkuteillä (0)
programme.desc: Petteri Kaniini, kujeileva ja seikkailuja rakastava sankari palaa uudessa elokuvassa Petteri Kaniini: Kani karkuteillä. Bea, Thomas ja kanit muodostavat ihanan eriskummallisen perheen, jossa Petteri yrityksestään huolimatta ei pääse vekkulimaisesta maineestaan eroon. Päätyessään seikkailuillaan puutarhan ulkopuolelle Petteri löytää itsensä maailmasta, jossa kujeilua arvostetaan. Kuitenkin hänen perheensä joutuessa vaaraan etsiessään häntä Petterin on päätettävä, millainen kani hän haluaa olla.

programme.desc: Maracuda, arvostetun heimojohtajan poika, kamppailee täyttääkseen isänsä odotukset. Hän lähtee salaperäiseen metsään todistamaan kykynsä ja tapaa siellä Tinkin – taianomaisen linnun ulkoavaruudesta. Yhdessä he seikkailevat uskomattomissa kivikautisissa metsissä, mutta seikkailun tiimellyksessä Tink muuttaa vahingossa Maracudan isän pikkuruiseksi olennoksi, ja pojan on opetettava Tinkiä hallitsemaan voimiaan. Unohtumattomat kokemukset opettavat Maracudaa kantamaan vastuuta, ja hänen isänsä puolestaan oppii ymmärtämään poikaansa.

programme.title: Jättipäärynä, joka kasvoi talon kokoiseksi (0)

programme.title: Itse ilkimys 2 (0)
programme.desc: Superkonna Gru on jättänyt rikollisen elämän taakseen ja omistautunut hoivaamaan kolmea suloista ottotytärtään. Leppoisa perhe-elämä saa kuitenkin vauhdikkaan käänteen, kun kuvaan astuu viehättävä agentti Lucy, joka on päättänyt värvätä yksinhuoltajaisän taisteluun uutta suurkelmiä vastaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (7)
programme.desc: Yhdistettyään jälleen voimansa Gwen Stacyn kanssa Brooklynin naapuruston kokopäiväinen ystävällinen Spider-Man sinkoutuu multiversumiin, missä hän kohtaa joukon hämähäkki-ihmisiä, joiden tehtävänä on suojella olemassaoloaan. Sisältää välkkyviä valoja, jotka saattavat aiheuttaa epileptisen kohtauksen.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife (12)
programme.desc: Elokuvassa Ghostbusters: Afterlife yksihuoltajaäiti kahden lapsensa kanssa saapuu pikkukaupunkiin ja alkaa huomata yhteyden alkuperäisiin ghostbusterseihin ja isoisänsä jättämään salaiseen perintöön.

programme.title: Sleeping with Other People (15)
programme.desc: Opiskeluaikaisesta yhden illan jutusta on kulunut kaksitoista vuotta, kun Lainey ja Jake tapaavat sattumalta ja toteavat, että heillä on sama ongelma: kumpikaan ei ole kyennyt kestävään parisuhteeseen.
